api_latest_records.accounting_note: Locally recomputed from saved response; no new API request. Includes cache-write tokens at published default 30m rate. Legacy retention field and absent lifetime detail retained as a reporting caveat.

caveats: Durations/times are locally reported. Same-second ends sort before starts.
Model generation calls are deduplicated by call_id; polling/accounting rows are not separate generations.
Session-token usage, deployment identifier, invoice and normal-tool billing remain unobservable.

paired_test.interpretation: No complete paired native score comparison. Zero raw counts at common_cases=0 are empty counts, not observed zero sensitivity or stability.
